observation.command: date; tail -3 /tmp/app-serve2.log; echo "=== ready now ==="; curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:3000/health/ready | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);console.log('status=',j.status,'db=',j.checks.db,'redis=',j.checks.redis,'keycloak=',j.checks.keycloak,'jobWorker=',j.checks.services?.jobWorker?.status,'errs=',JSON.stringify(j.checks.errors));})"
